  "per_column": [
    {"name": "clinical_problem_type", "analytical_usefulness": 0.95, "source_groundedness": 0.92, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Strong categorical axis directly answering 'what patient needs appear'. Values well-grounded (annual physical=preventive, cough/fever=acute, post-MI follow-up=chronic). Acne classified as chronic_disease_management is defensible."},
    {"name": "acuity_complexity", "analytical_usefulness": 0.85, "source_groundedness": 0.8, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Useful severity axis for grouping. Somewhat correlated with existing 'urgency' but adds finer clinical gradation. Grounding mostly sound; the annual-physical row as low_acuity is fine, but acuity labels partly infer beyond explicit text."},
    {"name": "care_action_required", "analytical_usefulness": 0.9, "source_groundedness": 0.88, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Directly captures actionable needs, high analytical leverage. Values track text well (labs ordered, monitoring, medication initiation, MRI). Sound extraction."},
    {"name": "specialist_involvement", "analytical_usefulness": 0.8, "source_groundedness": 0.75, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Useful for grouping, but values essentially mirror the existing 'department' column, making it partly redundant. Grounded via department mapping."},
    {"name": "diagnostic_workup_need", "analytical_usefulness": 0.88, "source_groundedness": 0.82, "hallucination_observed": true, "rationale": "Genuine new axis on workup needs. Mostly grounded, but the annual-physical row (lipid panel + HbA1c, both labs) labeled 'multi_modal' overstates modality diversity; a minor inconsistency."},
    {"name": "medication_need_type", "analytical_usefulness": 0.85, "source_groundedness": 0.85, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Distinct, valuable medication axis. NULL/absent handled correctly for silent rows. Values grounded (statin=chronic, doxycycline=new_prescription)."},
    {"name": "preventive_or_wellness_need", "analytical_usefulness": 0.8, "source_groundedness": 0.7, "hallucination_observed": true, "rationale": "Useful preventive axis, mostly correct with 'not_present' for silent rows. But the annual-physical row labeled 'chronic_disease_prevention' is an unwarranted specific; the text describes routine screening, not stated chronic disease prevention."},
    {"name": "specialist_or_ancillary_involvement", "analytical_usefulness": 0.15, "source_groundedness": 0.75, "hallucination_observed": false, "rationale": "Exact duplicate of 'specialist_involvement' (identical top values and row values); a mere restatement adding no analytical leverage."}
  ],
  "analytical_usefulness": 0.78,
  "source_groundedness": 0.82,
  "rationale": "Most columns provide genuine, distinct analytical axes (problem type, acuity, care action, workup, medication, prevention) that directly serve the query about patient needs and are largely well-grounded in the visit notes. Deductions: specialist_or_ancillary_involvement is a verbatim duplicate of specialist_involvement (no leverage), and both specialist columns largely restate the existing department field. Minor grounding issues appear in over-specific labels (e.g., annual physical tagged chronic_disease_prevention and multi_modal workup for two lab tests). Silent-row 'not_present'/NULL values are handled correctly and not penalized."
}
